targets.value: You spot the pattern, offer a clear solution, and are ready to move on. Naming an owner gives the work a clear path after your momentum, instead of letting a good idea fade in the meeting.

When someone avoids a point or their tone changes, you notice what actually shifted before deciding what it means. That pause helps keep a quick exit from taking over and gives the disagreement a specific way to repair.
Watch for treating a clipped tone as proof of intent before naming its effect.
